clue.text: English soldier's news about European war machine

indicators.note: about means going around, so one piece encloses the soldier

parts.note: read as new-s, the plural of N, the abbreviation for new: two Ns
GI is an American soldier; the 's is part of the surface

explanation.surface: A British soldier passes on word about a continental weapon of war.
explanation.walkthrough: 'news' is read cryptically as the plural of new, so N twice, placed 'about' the soldier GI.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically an engine was any mechanical device for warfare, such as a siege catapult or battering ram.

clue.text: To make sense of Sun puzzle, many go on and on

indicators.note: to puzzle the letters is to jumble them up, so they are rearranged

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, standing in for a large number
to ramble is to talk at tedious length

explanation.surface: To understand a newspaper puzzle, plenty of solvers talk endlessly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'puzzle' rearranges SUN into UNS; C as 'many' is a crossword convention for a large Roman number.
explanation.definitionFit: Unscrambling a garbled message means decoding it so that it becomes understandable.

clue.text: They deliver former US tennis player's son

parts.note: Jim Courier was an American tennis champion of the 1990s
S is the abbreviation for son in family trees

explanation.surface: A retired tennis star's son seems to be doing deliveries.
explanation.definitionFit: Messengers who carry parcels and documents from sender to recipient are what the definition describes.

clue.text: Move fast through detailed terms and conditions?

parts.note: detailed terms are the small print; small is shortened to its first letter
the print of a contract is its written terms

explanation.surface: Racing through the fine-detail clauses of a contract without reading them.
explanation.walkthrough: Detailed terms and conditions are the 'small print', with small abbreviated to S; 'through' just joins.
explanation.definitionFit: A dash at top speed over a short distance is a running burst, so the verb means to go very quickly.

clue.text: It would be dangerous for showman to do this in a plane

definitions.text: It would be dangerous for showman to do this in a plane

parts.words: It would be dangerous for showman to do this in a plane
parts.note: a fire-breathing showman spits fire; the famous British wartime fighter aircraft

explanation.surface: A circus fire-breather performing aboard an aircraft would be a hazard.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as SPIT FIRE it is the fire-eater's trick; whole, it names the Second World War fighter plane.
explanation.definitionFit: A Supermarine fighter aircraft flown by the RAF in the Battle of Britain carries this name.

clue.text: Star more annoyed being in last place

indicators.note: annoyed suggests the letters have been stirred up and disturbed

explanation.surface: A celebrity is even more irritated at finishing bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: Furthest back of all in a line is the same as occupying the final position.

clue.text: Playing well, half-naked and relaxed

parts.note: a player performing well is in form

indicators.note: naked means stripped of its covering, so the outer letters of the word go

explanation.surface: Performing well while half-dressed, and perfectly at ease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half-naked' is the word half 'naked', stripped of its outer letters to leave AL.
explanation.definitionFit: Casual and unceremonious behaviour is laid-back, without formality.

clue.text: Postman reported?

indicators.note: reported signals that the word is spoken and heard

parts.note: a man is male

explanation.surface: A query about whether a letter carrier was the subject of a report.
explanation.definitionFit: Letters and parcels sent through the postal system are the same thing as what is posted.

clue.text: Cat joins in conversation

indicators.note: in conversation means as spoken, so a word that is heard alike

parts.note: joins means connects or links

explanation.surface: A feline takes part in the chat.
explanation.definitionFit: The short-tailed wild feline with tufted ears is one species in the cat family.

clue.text: Secretly solicit a liaison in a foreign country

indicators.note: Secretly says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Discreetly arranging an affair while abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Italy's name in its own language is a foreign country to an English reader.

clue.text: Sign name for an arachnid

parts.note: Scorpio is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: Appears to ask you to supply a name for a spider-like creature.
explanation.definitionFit: Stinging eight-legged creatures with pincers belong to the same class as spiders.

clue.text: Female team startled after loud siren

indicators.note: after places the anagram after the abbreviation for loud

parts.note: F is forte, the musical direction for loud

indicators.note: startled suggests the letters jump about in alarm

explanation.surface: A women's side jumps in fright at a loud alarm siren.
explanation.definitionFit: A seductive, dangerous woman who lures men to ruin is a siren, like the sea nymphs of myth.

clue.text: A posh doctor orbits moon and earth, a recording enthusiast

parts.note: U means upper-class, as in U and non-U

indicators.note: orbits means circles round, so the doctor goes around the moon

parts.note: a DPhil is an Oxford doctorate
Io is a moon of Jupiter

explanation.surface: An upper-class astronomer circles the moon and earth, while being a hi-fi fan.
explanation.walkthrough: U for upper-class is a British convention; DPhil is Oxford's name for a doctorate.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone passionate about high-quality sound reproduction is a hi-fi lover.

clue.text: Animal's about to spill red wine, not whiskey

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: spilling the words throws their letters into disorder
not removes the following letter from the wine

parts.note: Whiskey is W in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A beast is about to knock over a glass of red, though not the spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: Whiskey is W in the NATO alphabet, so 'not whiskey' strips it from the wine before 'to spill' scrambles what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: The antlered deer of Arctic regions, famed for pulling Santa's sleigh, is a kind of creature.

clue.text: Following film, create remake and such like

indicators.note: Following puts the rearranged word after the film

parts.note: ET is Spielberg's film about an extra-terrestrial

indicators.note: a remake makes the word over again in a new order

explanation.surface: After one movie, produce a remake and other films of that sort.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase meaning 'and the rest' closes a list of similar things.

clue.text: Settled group covered in embarrassment

indicators.note: covered in means the group is wrapped inside the colour

parts.note: embarrassment makes one go red
a side is a team or group

explanation.surface: A team that has made a decision is red-faced with shame.
explanation.definitionFit: Having lived in a place, having made a home there, is to have settled.

clue.text: Mineral water at last stolen from room — it led to move

indicators.note: to move means the letters are shifted into a new order
stolen from means a letter is taken away from the pool
at last picks the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: Water was taken from a room, which caused a relocation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to move' rearranges ROOM IT LED once 'stolen from' removes the R that ends 'water'.
explanation.definitionFit: A calcium magnesium carbonate rock-forming substance, giving its name to the Italian Dolomites.

clue.text: Most occupied vehicle that's by street

parts.note: a bus is a vehicle
ie, id est, means that is

explanation.surface: The bus parked by the street is the most packed one.
explanation.definitionFit: Having the most to do, the fullest schedule, is being the most occupied.

clue.text: Ladies and gents key to replace small coins

parts.note: the Ladies and the Gents are public toilets, or loos
E is a musical key
to change something is to replace it

explanation.surface: The key to the public toilets has to be replaced.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain 'the Ladies' and 'the Gents' are the women's and men's public toilets.
explanation.definitionFit: Coins of low value in a pocket or purse are what the definition means.

clue.text: Announcer's hard time — line dead

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A broadcaster has a tough time when the phone line goes dead.
explanation.definitionFit: A messenger who proclaims news was the role of a royal official making proclamations.

clue.text: Male finally beats children's game

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word

parts.note: tag is the chasing game played in playgrounds

explanation.surface: A man ends up winning a playground game.
explanation.definitionFit: An adult male deer is the plain sense, extended to a man going alone to a party.

clue.text: Omen: good beset by evil

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded, so the good is enclosed by the evil

parts.note: sin is evil

explanation.surface: A portent warns of goodness surrounded by wickedness.
explanation.definitionFit: A portent or indication of things to come is a synonym for an omen.

clue.text: Even mummy quietly puts on top back to front and succeeds!

indicators.note: putting on a garment means being inside it, so the letters go within
back to front means the garment word is written in reverse

parts.note: a shirt is a top

indicators.note: Even picks the second and fourth letters of the word

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: Even an Egyptian mummy, wearing its shirt backwards, wins through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back to front' turns SHIRT into TRIHS, which goes around UMP.
explanation.definitionFit: Winning victories or prevailing is to triumph, which is achieving success.

clue.text: Stop period of cold weather

definitions.meaning: to stop still, to stand motionless
a spell of frost when temperatures fall below zero

explanation.definitionFit: To halt motionless and a spell of icy weather are both expressed by the same word.

clue.text: Criminal stealing the family jewels?

indicators.note: criminal suggests the letters have been corrupted into a new order

explanation.surface: A crook pilfering the heirlooms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'family jewels' is slang for male private parts, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Jocular slang for the reproductive organs, particularly male, is the family jewels.

clue.text: Woman's part of mass

definitions.meaning: the hymn of praise sung in the Mass

explanation.surface: A lady takes a role in the church service.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a girl's name and the Latin hymn forming part of the Catholic liturgy.
